description: This file defines the MerchantConfig class, which models configuration settings for a merchant in the application. It includes display options, search configurations, and methods for serializing to JSON.

classes.name: MerchantConfig
classes.description: A Java class representing merchant configuration settings, including display options and search configurations, with json serialization support.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JSON string representing its current configuration state.

methods.name: setDisplayCustomerSection
methods.description: Sets whether to display the customer section.

methods.name: isDisplayCustomerSection
methods.description: Returns whether the customer section display is enabled.

methods.name: setDisplayContactUs
methods.description: Sets whether to display the contact us section.

methods.name: isDisplayContactUs
methods.description: Returns whether the contact us display is enabled.

methods.name: setDisplayStoreAddress
methods.description: Sets whether to display the store address.

methods.name: isDisplayStoreAddress
methods.description: Returns whether the store address display is enabled.

methods.name: setUseDefaultSearchConfig
methods.description: Sets the map for default search configuration.

methods.name: getUseDefaultSearchConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the map for default search configuration.

methods.name: setDefaultSearchConfigPath
methods.description: Sets the map for default search config paths.

methods.name: getDefaultSearchConfigPath
methods.description: Retrieves the map for default search config paths.

methods.name: setDisplayAddToCartOnFeaturedItems
methods.description: Enables or disables displaying add to cart on featured items.

methods.name: isDisplayAddToCartOnFeaturedItems
methods.description: Returns whether adding to cart on featured items is enabled.
